Please read our Frequently Asked Question (FAQ):

Q:

What currency is accepted?

A: Australia Dollar (AUD).

Q:

How to create an account?

A: Click the "REGISTER" button on the homepage to

register. After successful registration, Click the "DEPOSIT" button

to topup and click the "WITHDRAW" button to withdraw money.

Q:

Can I register multiple accounts?

A: No, VIP99 strictly prohibit the registration of multiple

accounts. Once the rules are violated, the account will be restricted and many

benefits will be lost.  (1 NAME / 1ID / 1 ACCOUNT / 1 IP ONLY)

Q:

What are the deposit and withdrawal limits?

A: The minimum deposit is AUD 10. 

The minimum withdraw is AUD30. Withdrawal are limited to 5 times per day.

  • Withdrawals are limited to 5 times a day. 
  • Max Withdraw = Deposit Amount x 150 Times
  • Max Payout for All Pokies Games AUD100000.

Q:

Winnings Hold Allowed?

A: Withdrawal Policy for Gameplay Winnings

  • Players must withdraw any game play winnings within 7 days from the date of winning.
  • After 7 days, if no withdrawal is made, the system will automatically forfeit the winning amounts.
  • It is allowed to keep deposit balances in the wallet beyond this period.
  • However, we do not support holding gameplay winnings in the wallet long-term and requesting withdrawal after extended periods.

We strongly advise all players to withdraw their winnings promptly to avoid any loss.

Q:

Can I top up if I still have balance?

A: In order to avoid confusion in the bonus rules, You must play and bet your credit after each deposit. Once the credit are lower than AUD 0.5 or after withdrawal, You will be able to submit the deposit again.

Q:

What is our Rollover and Turnover?

A: ROLLOVER : Total bet in game. TURNOVER : Minimum withdraw

amount

Q:

Can I claim different bonus at the same time?

A: No, You cannot apply at the same time for any Promotion, Bonus,

Rebate, Commission & Angpau,.etc. Although you can sometimes click on

multiple different bonuses, this will superimpose the withdrawal rules on different bonuses. Once the rules are violated will forfeit the bonus.

Q:

I have met the Rollover requirements, why can't I withdraw money?

A: Deposit and applying for some bonus will have rollover

requirements. Once you complete the rollover requirements, please exit the game

completely and give the system some time to update the Rollover progress bar.

Once the Rollover progress bar is full, withdrawals can be made.

Q:

Can I change my bank account?

A: In order to protect the bank accounts of both of us, VIP99 do not allow customers to change the bank account, Unless your registered account

is frozen/blocked, VIP99 will verify the authenticity and ask for some supporting documents.

Q:

What should I do if I cannot receive the verification code?

A: To register a new user or reset a password if you forget your

password, Need to request a verification code, But sometimes can't receive the

verification code. For security reasons, Users cannot ask us directly in Live

Chat. After contacting our customer service, We will provide two ways for us to verify the authenticity of the membership number.

Q:

Can customer service create an account for me?

A: No, For the authenticity of the user, The user must register

and accept the mobile phone verification code, Please click the

"REGISTER" button on the homepage to register.
